description: This file contains utility functions for the Playwright recorder, including frame and selector handling, action merging, and call log generation.

methods.name: buildFullSelector
methods.description: Constructs a full selector string from a frame path and a selector.

methods.name: metadataToCallLog
methods.description: Converts call metadata into a structured call log object.

methods.name: mainFrameForAction
methods.description: Retrieves the main frame associated with a given action in context.

methods.name: frameForAction
methods.description: Resolves and returns the frame for a specific action with a selector.

methods.name: shouldMergeAction
methods.description: Determines if two actions should be merged based on their properties.

methods.name: collapseActions
methods.description: Merges consecutive actions that meet merging criteria into a single action.

methods.name: generateFrameSelector
methods.description: Generates a sequence of selectors for a frame and its ancestors.
